observed_anchor: Current parser syntax and nominal typechecker admit String literals/types, but the canonical ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1 lowerer accepts only BOOL/NUMBER literals and rejects STRING before the VM adapter.

discriminating_test.source:
module clay.entityos.stringgate
fn main() -> String { return "EntityOS-String-OK" }
discriminating_test.observed_error: ExecutableTypedIRError: literal outside executable TypedIR v1 PURE subset: STRING

hypothesis: The smallest product-convergent next patch is a canonical UTF-8 String value path from Clay literal -> ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1 -> VM bootstrap IR -> serialized ClayVM -> ClayOS/run result, with explicit bounds and no host/Python semantic substitution.
counterhypothesis: String should wait until Bytes/Buffer ownership and lifetime semantics are fixed together, because a String-only VM representation could create a second incompatible data model or force later byte-layout migration.
falsifier_for_patch: A patched exact-head EntityOS must build and run the String source above to the exact Unicode/UTF-8 String value, preserve existing Int/Bool/provenance/capability gates, and continue rejecting unsupported Bytes/argv/effects rather than guessing them.

unusual_experiment.note: No additional unusual experiment was initiated for this negative-result receipt; the cycle's bounded relocation/environment experiment is recorded in the preceding exact-head receipt.

next_executable_action: Implement the smallest bounded canonical UTF-8 String representation end-to-end through ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1 and the single serialized ClayVM, add exact String build/run regression to EntityOS self-test/VPS gate, then separately derive Bytes/Buffer ownership and argv from that typed data contract rather than encoding them as opaque integer handles.
